sehemu: Part II: Consolidated Fund and Finances of the United Republic
jina: Controller and Auditor-General of the United Republic
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Controller and Auditor-General of the United Republic. (2) The Controller and Auditor-General shall have responsibility for the following matters— (a) to ensure that any money proposed to be withdrawn from the Consolidated Fund has been authorized for withdrawal and that the money shall be withdrawn in accordance with the provisions of Article 136 of this Constitution, and if he is satisfied that those provisions will be duly complied with, then he shall authorize such money to be withdrawn; (b) to ensure that all the money the payment of which has been authorized to be charged on the Consolidated Fund of the Government of the United Republic, or the money the use of which has been authorized by an Act of Parliament and which has been spent, has been applied to the purposes connected with the use of such money and that such expenditure was made in accordance with the authorization for such expenditure; and (c) at least once every year to audit and give an audit report in respect of the accounts of the Government of the United Republic, the accounts managed by all officers of the Government of the United Republic, the accounts of all courts of the United Republic and the accounts managed by the Clerk of the National Assembly. (3) The Controller and Auditor-General, and every public officer authorized by him, shall have a right to examine books, records, statements, reports and all other documents concerning any type of account referred to in subarticle (2) of this Article. (4) The Controller and Auditor-General shall submit to the President every report he makes pursuant to the provisions of subarticle (2) of this Article. Upon receipt of such report, the President shall direct the persons concerned to submit that report before the first sitting of the National Assembly which shall be held after the President has received the report and it shall have to be submitted to such sitting before the expiration of seven days from the day the sitting of the National Assembly began. If the President does not take steps to submit such report to the National Assembly, then the Controller and Auditor-General shall submit the report to the Speaker of the National Assembly, or the Deputy Speaker if the office of the Speaker is vacant or if for any reason the Speaker is unable to perform the functions of his office, and the Speaker or Deputy Speaker shall submit the report to the National Assembly. (5) The Controller and Auditor-General shall also perform such other functions, and shall have such other powers, as may be specified by law concerning the accounts of the Government of the United Republic, the accounts of public authorities and other public bodies or corporations. (6) In the exercise of his powers under the provisions of subarticles (2), (3) and (4) of this Article, the Controller and Auditor-General shall not be obliged to comply with the order or direction of any other person or Government Department, but the provisions of this Article shall not prevent a court from exercising jurisdiction to inquire into whether the Controller and Auditor-General has exercised his powers in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution or not.
